content:
Ravi: hey folks—need a short swap for my Sat night oncall (00:00–08:00 UTC). I'm headed to a spot with flaky mobile; can someone cover 00:00–06:00 UTC? I can shadow the last 2 hours (06:00–08:00) on a weak connection and do the final handback if needed. I'll prewarm the main model and leave runbook notes before I go. Link to runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/oncall-prewarm

Nina: I can take 00:00–04:00. Happy to prewarm and monitor canary for the first 2 hours as well.

Maya: I can pick up 04:00–08:00 (so that covers the handback window). I'll keep an eye on latency and the cache metrics.

Sam: If Nina's doing 00:00–04:00, I can cover 00:00–02:00 instead and shadow for the first hour with her—makes it easier if anyone needs fast paging.

Ravi: thanks all — sounds like we can do: Sam 00:00–02:00, Nina 02:00–04:00, Maya 04:00–08:00? Nina you said 00:00–04:00, so if you're good shifting to 02:00–04:00 that'd be perfect. Otherwise Sam will stick to 00–02 and Nina keep 00–04 and Maya do 04–08. whichever you prefer.

Nina: I can trim to 02:00–04:00 no problem. prefer to be fresh later in the morning.

Sam: ok i'll take 00:00–02:00 then. quick note: i'll run prewarm for customer-batch model at 23:45 UTC and confirm in thread when done.

Ravi: appreciated. prewarm commands I ran (for reference):
```
# prewarm cache for main model
prewarm --model customer-batch --tokens 1024 --region eu-west-1
# check cache
curl -s https://metrics.internal/cache?model=customer-batch | jq '.hit_rate'
```
I'll paste the exact logs before I go. Also note: there is an ongoing canary for quantized-v2 — if latency spikes >200ms for p95 please escalate to the pagers and switch routing to quantized-v1 fallback (see routing policy in runbook).

Maya: noted about fallback. i'll add a fragment to the handoff: "if quantized-v2 p95 > 200ms for 5min -> route to quantized-v1; open a ticket with infra and ping @oncall-ops".

Oncall Bot: rota updated: provisional swaps recorded (Sam: 00:00–02:00, Nina: 02:00–04:00, Maya: 04:00–08:00). Please confirm by reacting with :thumbsup:.

Zoe: thanks team — confirmed on my side, i'll update the official schedule spreadsheet and slack calendar. Ravi, safe travels — leave your final handoff in the thread when you're on the plane and we'll mark it done. :thumbsup:

Ravi: will do, posting logs + final note ~30m before departure. really appreciate the cover everyone :heart:
